audit.why: Both layers agree row for row (Neeko / Skill / Kled / Kled / Neeko / Kled / Kled) and that matches the packet chart and a flat 50.00% over 140 games. No flips needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said her R 'interrupts your R charge and your E dash mid-air' but never gave its range, and missed the mechanic that actually makes it land.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 600 range on 120/105/90, and Riot's text states the preparation is hidden while Neeko is disguised. The hidden wind-up, not the interrupt, is why players eat it.
audit.corrected: whys[4] rewritten to the 600 range, the knock-up-then-stun, and the disguised wind-up being invisible.
sources: champ-data/_kits/neeko.json (R Pop Blossom, range 600, cd 120/105/90, 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised')

audit.whatIsWrong: Every line said 'dodge Tangle-Barbs' without the mechanic that makes it un-dodgeable: if it kills a unit or passes through a champion it becomes larger, faster, and roots longer.
audit.why: That means the root you actually eat is the upgraded one, and you feed the upgrade yourself by standing behind low-health minions. Positioning relative to the wave is the counterplay, not reaction speed.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d rewritten to the upgrade condition and not standing behind low-HP minions.
sources: champ-data/_kits/neeko.json (E Tangle-Barbs: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer')

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the abilities were never named in the content layer's whys. Q was 'her Q poke' and E was 'her E root' throughout.
audit.why: Blooming Burst and Tangle-Barbs are the real names, and the numbers behind them (Q 800 range on 9s, E 1000 range on 12s at rank 1) are what make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[2] and whys[4] now name Blooming Burst, Tangle-Barbs and Pop Blossom with their ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Several full-layer lines call Neeko 'he' and 'his'.
audit.why: Neeko is female and the content layer already uses 'she' — the page contradicts itself in the same matchup.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.feeding corrected to she/her.

edits.before: She pokes you with Q while you have no spammable answer — preserve Skaarl's health and last-hit at range instead of trading.
edits.after: Blooming Burst reaches 800 like your trap and re-blooms on a champion hit — preserve Skaarl's health and last-hit instead of trading.

edits.before: The full E-W-E re-E combo lands before she can E-root and kite away — one all-in halves a squishy mage.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 — once it misses, E in, W's four attacks, then re-E back halves a squishy mage.

edits.before: Her R can interrupt your charge and your dash, but if you bait it first your all-in still wins — the cooldown decides each fight.
edits.after: Pop Blossom knocks up then stuns from 600, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised — an ally walking at you is the tell.

edits.before: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs grows if it kills a minion en route — never stand behind low-HP minions.

edits.before: Beartrap Neeko when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Beartrap Neeko when her answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.

edits.before: That is Neeko's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Neeko's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.

edits.before: If Neeko gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Tangle-Barbs. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If he snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.
edits.after: If Neeko gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Tangle-Barbs. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

notes: Neeko's passive lets her disguise as an ALLY champion, so the 'clone-baited' framing in the existing text conflates Shapesplitter (W, a directional clone) with Inherent Glamour (P, the ally disguise). I left those lines alone rather than rewrite them on a guess about which one the author meant. Whether Kled's E dash can be interrupted mid-air by Pop Blossom's stun is not stated in the kit file — I wrote 'knocks up then stuns' only, and did not repeat the mid-air interrupt claim as fact.
